 Position Summary 

 We are seeking a highly motivated and tech-savvy co-op student to join our Supply Chain team for a 1-year term. This role is ideal for a student with a passion for automation, data, and artificial intelligence who wants to make a tangible impact on how supply chain processes are executed and optimized.
 The successful candidate will support the development, customization, and deployment of AI-driven tools and automation solutions that enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and strategic value of supply chain operations.
  
 The successful candidate will gain:
 
• Hands-on experience applying AI and automation in a real-world business context. 
• Exposure to supply chain operations and enterprise systems. 
• Opportunity to contribute to meaningful digital transformation initiatives. 
• Mentorship from experienced professionals in supply chain and technology.  
 Key Areas of Responsibility 

• Collaborate with Supply Chain, and IT teams to identify automation opportunities within supply chain workflows. 
• Assist in the design, development, and deployment of AI tools (e.g., chatbots, document analyzers, predictive models) tailored to supply chain needs. 
• Customize existing AI solutions to align with internal processes and compliance requirements. 
• Support integration of AI tools with supply chain platforms (e.g., ERP systems, internal management tools, price lists). 
• Conduct testing, validation, and performance monitoring of deployed solutions. 
• Document processes, user guides, and training materials for internal stakeholders. 
• Stay current with emerging technologies in AI, machine learning, and supply chain automation.  
 Required Skills and Experience 

• Currently enrolled in a post-secondary program in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Technology Management, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. 
• Strong interest in procurement, supply chain, and business operations. 
• Hands-on experience with Python. 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail. 
• Strong written and verbal communication skills. 
• Proficiency with standard computer applications and the ability to learn new systems and concepts quickly. 
• Ability to work both independently with minimal supervision and collaboratively within a cross-functional team. 
• Ability to apply technical knowledge, analytical thinking, and sound judgment to support supply chain systems and processes.  
 Preferred Qualifications 

• Co-op student available for a 12-month term, with at least one additional academic term remaining after completion of the internship. 
• Previous co-op or internship experience is an asset. 
• Power Automate or other automation tools is an asset. 
• Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and tools (e.g., OpenAI, Azure AI, TensorFlow) is a plus.   
• Scientific background or additional business education or experience considered a plus.
